findings.what_happened: The program claimed that Passage [1] explicitly states Ken Howard played 'not an attorney', whereas Passage [1] only states 'Ken Howard as Phelan Beale (Little Edie's father)' and does not state that the role was not an attorney.
findings.quote: Passage [1] explicitly states that Ken Howard played the role of Phelan Beale (Little Edie's father) in Grey Gardens, not an attorney.

findings.what_happened: The program concluded that the claim was false based on the incorrect assumption that playing Phelan Beale meant he did not play an attorney.
findings.quote: he played the character Phelan Beale (Little Edie's father), not an attorney.

findings.what_happened: The program repeated the incorrect claim that Passage [1] identified his role as 'not an attorney'.
